inputs.text: [excited] Here comes the Jurassic! [happily] A hundred and eighty million years ago. [chuckles] Its name comes from the Jura mountains, [playful] between France and Switzerland.
[curious] Had the continents moved?
[amazed] [pauses] Pangea is starting to crack. [calm] A long split opens in the middle, [softly] and a sea slowly moves in.
[curious] Is it hot?
[happily] Hot and humid! [playful] Big forests of ferns grow everywhere, [calm] with conifers and ginkgos.
[gasps] What's a ginkgo?
[chuckles] A tree with leaves shaped like little fans. [amazed] And here's the wild part: it's still around today, [softly] almost exactly the same!
[excited] And the dinos ate all of that?
[happily] Tons of it! [excited] So much food that the plant-eaters grew gigantic. [shouts] Diplodocus was eighty-five feet long, almost as long as a basketball court!
[amazed] Whoa…
[warmly] Brachiosaurus held its long neck straight up, [calm] like a crane, [softly] to nibble the tops of the trees.
[curious] Why were they so big?
[serious] That long neck let them eat without moving their feet. [calm] And inside, their bones, [softly] were full of tiny air pockets, [playful] light like a bird's.
[curious] What about the meat-eaters?
[excited] Allosaurus hunted the plant-eaters. [serious] Sharp teeth, [softly] strong claws. [calm] And Stegosaurus defended itself with its spiky tail.
[curious] Were there animals in the sky?
[playful] Archaeopteryx! [gently] Almost a bird, almost a dinosaur, [softly] with feathers and little wings.
[curious] And in the sea?

[serious] Ophthalmosaurus hunted squid [calm] with its enormous eyes. [pauses] And Liopleurodon, [amazed] a powerful hunter twenty-three feet long, [softly] snapped its jaws shut on anything that swam by.
[hesitant] Twenty-three feet, [pauses] is that really big?
[chuckles] About as long as a big moving truck. [calm] Big, yes. But no bigger.
[curious] What comes after the Jurassic?
[excited] The continents keep drifting apart, [pauses] slowly, [happily] and something brand new is about to appear on Earth…
